# The integration tests that MUST execute and pass.
#
# Generated from jest itself, not typed by hand. One full name per line:
# describe path joined with the test title, exactly as jest reports
# assertionResults[].fullName.
#
# Its purpose is the same as the node-ID diff in security-acceptance.yml:
# without it, deleting or renaming a test silently shrinks the gate and the
# job still goes green. Regenerate deliberately when adding a test, never to
# make a red build pass.
#
# Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
conflict resolution against the real API merged stores the merged content, the note, and resolves the conflict
conflict resolution against the real API merged the merged memory exists, carries the typed content, and is embedded
conflict resolution against the real API merged both source memories are retired, not deleted
conflict resolution against the real API split ADDS a tag to each memory, preserving the tags already there
conflict resolution against the real API split both memories stay current — a split keeps both claims
conflict resolution against the real API split identical tags are accepted, as the resolver allows
conflict resolution against the real API deferred stores the revisit time as the correct UTC instant
conflict resolution against the real API deferred the conflict is deferred, not resolved
conflict resolution against the real API deferred both memories stay current — deferring decides nothing
conflict resolution against the real API deferred the note and the deferring user are persisted
conflict resolution against the real API deferred resolved_at stays NULL — a deferral is not a resolution
conflict resolution against the real API deferred blocks_derivation is unchanged — an open question still blocks
conflict resolution against the real API deferred revisit_at survives the fix — the new columns did not disturb it
conflict resolution against the real API deferred psql boolean rendering is t / f / empty-for-null, as assumed
conflict resolution against the real API errors a missing required field is refused in the form, with no request sent
conflict resolution against the real API errors a conflict that does not exist renders the neutral missing state
